reason: Confirmed from the cited source and one independent outlet. The SCTDA press release (sharjahtourism.ae, dateline Dubai, 30 April 2025) states: approximately 1.6 million hotel guests in 2024, an 11% increase over 2023; Russia first with over 270,000 guests (+18%); India second with over 170,000 (+6%); Europe over 100,000 (+16%); China over 60,000 (+828%); and among Arab markets Oman led with 6% of total guests, followed by Saudi Arabia 5%, Egypt 4%, Syria and Iraq 3% each. The independent TTN report (taimages.ognnews.com/news/TTN_432993.html, dateline Dubai, 30 April 2025) carries identical figures. WAM and Arabian Business also ran the story but could not be fetched (403/empty page). Every number, name, and date in the claim matches the source; the only omission is Europe's +16% growth, which is not an error. Note that Oman's 6% is a share of total guests, not a growth rate, which is how the claim phrases it.
